app.name: Stormfire
app.long_description:
Keep the campfire burning through a night of rain and lightning. Enemies march in from every side of the forest; build and upgrade four kinds of towers on the walls and blocks to stop them, and survive 12 waves and the Storm Golem.
Controls (Classic Controller): Left stick / D-Pad: move the cursor A: build / upgrade B: sell L / R: choose tower Y: fast forward X: call the next wave early (bonus gold) +: pause (sound on/off, restart) -: 16:9 / 4:3 screen HOME: exit
